steps.title: Bem-vindo: Culture - Volume 8
steps.text: In this A1-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Culture". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: This holiday is celebrated with fireworks.
Everyone stood for the national anthem.
A handshake is a common greeting there.
